_note: SOURCES ARE DATA, NOT CODE. Edit this file and the next sweep picks it up; no deploy needed. Every entry below names a REAL organisation and the best URL known at the time of writing, but the URLs were NOT reachable from the machine that wrote this file, so none is confirmed live. That is why they ship disabled. Run: node backend/tools/signals-check.mjs --all — it tests every source including the disabled ones, follows a site's own declared feed when the given URL is not one, and prints exactly which to set enabled. Flip those, and leave the rest alone. SECTOR: a source that only ever covers one of the six sectors names it here, and its items inherit that sector even when the headline does not repeat the word. Leave it empty for general trade press, where the sector is read from the text.

_fields.name: what it is, shown in the queue
_fields.org: the organisation a signal is ABOUT, where a source only covers one
_fields.url: the feed or listing page to read; an RSS or Atom feed works far better than a page
_fields.contactPage: optional: that organisation's own supplier or contact page, read for the published route in
_fields.verify: what is known and what is not — delete it once the source is checked
_fields.enabled: false until a person has checked the URL
